## About
Progressive Autosports began with one vision: to personalize automobiles using only the finest quality products. Each vehicle is individualized and treated as if it were our own.
We work on the finest automobiles, such as Mercedes, Bmw, Ferrari and Lamborghini. We carry original brands only, with no inferior copies and no blemished products, including Vellano, Brabus, Wald, TSW, Vredestein, Eclipse and Alpine.
Beyond wheels, the shop handles interiors, tint, wraps, paint and detail work. We pay attention to detail and focus on one vehicle at a time, so our clients can be reassured their vehicle is in the best hands.

## Services
- Wheels: Three piece wheels built to the highest standards, along with brands such as Vellano, TSW, Savini, Black Rhino and Redbourne.
- Kevlar Bed & Body Coating: Protective Kevlar coating for beds and bodies.
- Accident repairs: One reviewer had her SUV repaired after an accident and called the quality excellent.
- Blackout kit corrections: One client brought in a blackout kit the dealership had installed wrong, with clips missing and screws mismatched, and had it set right.
- Used cars: One buyer found a used car through Facebook Marketplace and says the paperwork was surprisingly simple.
- Photography / Video: Photography and video of your vehicle.

## FAQ
Q: What kinds of cars do you work on?
A: We work on the finest automobiles, such as Mercedes, Bmw, Ferrari and Lamborghini.

Q: Are your wheels and parts genuine?
A: Yes. We carry original brands only, and all our products are first line with no blemished products.

Q: How long does it take to buy a car?
A: One buyer says they walked in, bought a car, completed the paperwork and drove it home in under an hour.

Q: Can I book an appointment?
A: Yes. Reach out through our contact page or email sales@progressiveautosports.com to book an appointment.
